experiment: runtime use of transfer-validated uniform deformation rings

reference.asset: Opalescent white blown-glass candlestick, c. 1828, Sandwich Glass Museum
reference.license: CC0 / public domain dedication by Daderot
reference.local_media_policy: downloaded source photo stays in ignored runs/*/media; only derived evidence is committed
reference.measurement: OpenCV GrabCut followed by anchored component cleanup and rotational-symmetry reconstruction from the smaller visible half-width
uncertainty: single perspective photograph rather than an orthographic drawing
right-middle silhouette is partly obstructed by a black display tray
symmetry reconstruction assumes the museum object is rotationally symmetric
the derived mask is an auditable modeling proxy, not raw ground truth

held_out_rule: This candlestick was not used to create or transfer-validate the skill. No source mesh or source topology is available or inspected.

strategy.primary_object: one connected 12-sided radial quad shell shaped in Edit Mode
strategy.topology: start from a single cylinder, remove caps, use one planner-selected loop-cut transaction to establish 25 axial rings, then scale measured rings
strategy.boundary_policy: top and bottom remain intentionally open because this is a hollow blown-glass silhouette study
strategy.shading_policy: Smooth by Angle only after silhouette shaping; no weighted bevel because the reference transitions are rounded rather than intentionally sharp

required_skill_flow.execution: the planner-owned operation and every artistic ring scale must use begin/perform/verify/commit transactions

frozen_acceptance_gates.audit: fresh factory-startup Blender verifier passes without importing the generator

promotion_rule: append a successful runtime_usage record and promote status to RUNTIME_VALIDATED only if every frozen gate passes; otherwise retain TRANSFER_VALIDATED and record the failure
